name: Brand and Publishing OS
promise: Turn governed brand truth and sourced ideas into approved, traceable publications.
completion_criteria: BrandPackage carries identity, voice, audience, approved claims, assets, rules, version, and provenance.
Downstream consumers cannot silently mutate or republish canonical brand truth.
Brand Workshop's low-typing gated intake exists inside Brand System Maker with state parity.
Source ingest through review, dry-run execution, approval, and metrics retains one traceable chain.
Fixtures never claim real persistence, enrollment, commerce, deployment, or publication without those contracts.

waves.objective: Export one approved BrandPackage and consume it in a downstream dry run.
waves.acceptance: Schema validation, version pinning, provenance, and mutation protection are evidenced.

waves.objective: Map Brand Workshop's nine phases onto Brand Maker workspace state and gates.
waves.acceptance: Every phase is ported, rejected, or retained with behavior and recovery evidence.

waves.objective: Prove sourced draft to VCC review to dry-run publishing receipt.
waves.acceptance: SourceRecord, BrandPackage, human approval, artifact version, and dry-run status remain linked.

waves.objective: Wire multi-caller BrandPackage consumers and verify version-pinning boundaries.
waves.acceptance: Version-pinning and mutation-protection holds across multiple independent callers.

waves.objective: Implement 9 Brand Workshop phases into Brand Maker intake state and reconcile duplicate UX.
waves.acceptance: 9-phase state machine executes intake without data loss and produces canonical BrandPackage.

waves.objective: Extend dry-run receipt chain to formal VCC review with human approval gate simulation.
waves.acceptance: Draft verification and human signoff verified while preserving operator publish authority.
